supra4: Toyota Supra A80/Mk4 coupe, long rounded nose, multi-element oval lamps and large curved rear wing.
trueno: Toyota Sprinter Trueno AE86 THREE-door liftback, pop-up lamps closed, 1980s wedge and black lower panda trim. Not Levin fixed-headlamp or notchback.
yaris: Toyota Yaris T Sport first-generation XP10 THREE-door hatch, tall round roof, large vertical-ish headlamp units.
cerbera: TVR Cerbera low flowing two-door coupe, small circular/oval headlights and long bonnet, not Griffith convertible.
speed12: TVR Cerbera Speed 12 wide supercar as source, deep huge front grille and grouped circular lamps, large rear aero. Keep visible source aero; do not invent modern TVR.

s40: Volvo S40 T4 first-generation four-door saloon, small rectangular lamps and boxy boot.
s60: Volvo S60 first-generation four-door saloon, pronounced rounded shoulders and curved roof, not later S60.
corrado: Volkswagen Corrado VR6 two-door low hatch coupe, rectangular headlamps and short blunt nose.
g60: Volkswagen Golf Mk2 G60 three-door hatch, FOUR circular front lights and black arch trims as reference.
gti1: Volkswagen Golf Mk1 GTI three-door small angular hatch, round front lamps and black bumper/arch trims.
gti4: Volkswagen Golf Mk4 GTI three-door rounded hatch, clear multi-element rectangular lamps.
vr6: Volkswagen Golf Mk3 VR6 three-door hatch, original broad rectangular headlamps, not Mk4.
lupo: Volkswagen Lupo GTI tiny three-door hatch, round lamps and short rounded nose, not modern up!.
beetle: Volkswagen New Beetle first-generation 1990s closed coupe, circular roof and round fender lamps; retain reference rear wing, not original classic Beetle.
polo: Volkswagen Polo GTI 6N2 three-door hatch, rectangular lamps and small classic grille, not current Polo.
scirocco: Volkswagen Scirocco Mk2 angular two-door hatch coupe, FOUR rectangular front lamps and long sharp wedge profile, not later Mk3.
